title: Minimum Number of Lines to Cover Points
description:
You are given an array points where points[i] = [x i , y i ] represents a point on an X-Y plane. 
 
 Straight lines are going to be added to the X-Y plane, such that every point is covered by at least one line. 
 
 Return the minimum number of straight lines needed to cover all the points . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2022/01/23/image-20220123200023-1.png] 
 
```
Input:
 points = [[0,1],[2,3],[4,5],[4,3]]

Output:
 2

Explanation:
 The minimum number of straight lines needed is two. One possible solution is to add:
- One line connecting the point at (0, 1) to the point at (4, 5).
- Another line connecting the point at (2, 3) to the point at (4, 3).
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2022/01/23/image-20220123200057-3.png] 
 
```
Input:
 points = [[0,2],[-2,-2],[1,4]]

Output:
 1

Explanation:
 The minimum number of straight lines needed is one. The only solution is to add:
- One line connecting the point at (-2, -2) to the point at (1, 4).
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= points.length <= 10 
 
 points[i].length == 2 
 
 -100 <= x i , y i <= 100 
 
 All the points are unique .
